title: Evaluating BERT-based Scientific Relation Classifiers for Scholarly Knowledge Graph Construction on Digital Library Collections

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing confusion matrices and per-relation classification metrics (F1, Precision, Recall) to observe how the models disproportionately favor and misclassify instances as the majority relation type (e.g., USAGE) due to an unbalanced distribution of training samples.

Comparing model performance across combined heterogeneous corpora (SemEval18 and SciERC) to evaluate how inconsistent human annotation guidelines and semantic ambiguity in relation definitions affect the classifier's learnability and predictions.
